December 11, 2024 
NOTICE TO INDUSTRY 
ANNOUNCEMENT OF PARALLAX ENERGY OPERATING INC. AND VESTA ENERGY LTD. 
AMALGAMATION EFFECTIVE DECEMBER 4, 2024 
Please be advised that Vesta Energy Ltd. has amalgamated with Parallax Energy Operating Inc., effective December 4, 
2024, in accordance with the provisions of the Business Corporations Act (Alberta). The amalgamated corporation will 
continue under the name PARALLAX ENERGY OPERATING INC. 
A copy of the Certificate of Amalgamation is attached for your records. 
As a result of the foregoing, effective December 4, 2024, all notices, correspondence, invoices or payments formerly 
addressed to Vesta Energy Ltd. should now be issued in the name of Parallax Energy Operating Inc. Please update your 
records to the following mailing address: 
Parallax Energy Operating Inc. 
900, 520 – 3rd Avenue SW 
Calgary, Alberta, T2P 0R3, Canada 
Please circulate this notice to all departments within your organization and amend your records accordingly. 
Our business administration number and GST registration number remain unchanged.  Should you have any 
questions regarding this Notice, or require any additional information, please contact our office at the address 
noted. 
Yours truly, 
PARALLAX ENERGY OPERATING 
INC. 
Per: Dan Van Kessel, CFO 
900, 520 – 3rd Avenue SW 
Calgary, AB, T2P 0R3
